reason: A named lab with the report for my batch behind the QR code is the thing I normally have to dig for, and 200 mg bisglycinate with no oxide is a real dose. At $24.99 with the empty-box refund I'd try one box, but I'm not stocking up.
objection: Made in China and a brand with no reviews yet. I want to open the report and see that the batch number really matches before I trust it, and $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page didn't match the batch number, or the lab turned out not to be a real independent one, I'd pass.
